author: TEDx Talks
description:
In a world defined by constant disruption, leaders are expected to transform while navigating uncertainty and overload. Drawing on insights from neuroscience and her own experience guiding transformation, this talk shows how the human brain itself offers a powerful guide for leading change. By exploring how our minds integrate diverse perspectives, collaborate through shared alignment, and evolve through small, repeated steps, Fatma reframes leadership as the art of creating the right conditions for adaptation. The brain becomes a blueprint for building resilient teams, innovative institutions, and lasting momentum in times of change. 

Fatma Deniz is a neuroscientist and computer scientist shaped by a life across countries, disciplines, and communities. She is Vice President for Digitalization and Sustainability at TU Berlin and President-elect, set to assume office in April 2026. From 2026 to 2029, she is also an appointed member of the German Council for Sustainable Development.

title: A neuroscientist’s guide to better leadership | Fatma Deniz | TEDxBerlin Women

author: TEDx Talks
description: How can musical rhythm offer new creative and expressive possibilities? Drawing on contemporary compositions and interactive examples, this talk rethinks irregular rhythm as a powerful tool for expression, showing listeners and musicians how challenging rhythms can feel intuitive, fluid, and expressive. Described as “a composer that rocks” by the New York Times, Pascal Le Boeuf is a GRAMMY-award-winning composer and pianist whose research explores the intersection of improvised music, notation-based chamber music, and production-based technologies. His creative work focuses on rhythmic innovation—particularly metric irregularity, polyrhythm, and entrainment—as creative and performative resources. Pascal is an Assistant Professor of Music at MIT and holds a PhD in Music Composition from Princeton University. This talk was given at a TEDx event using the TED conference format but independently organized by a local community. Learn more at https://www.ted.com/tedx
title: Against the Grid: Explorations in Musical Rhythm | Pascal Le Boeuf | TEDxMIT

author: TEDx Talks
description: Trinity reflects on growing up in many places—Ugandan by passport, yet feeling foreign—and discovering the power of belonging to many nations. Trinity Kamugisha is a yearly 12 student that passionately explores the themes of identity,culture and belonging in an increasingly interconnected world. Through storytelling and reflection,she highlights the power of connection in bridging diverse communities and perspectives. She focuses on how living between cultures can create understanding and unity across differences. Trinity further breaks down the ways in which people can connect different countries and cultures. This talk was given at a TEDx event using the TED conference format but independently organized by a local community. Learn more at https://www.ted.com/tedx
title: The bridge named me | Trinity Kamugisha | TEDxYouth@BrookhouseSchool

author: TEDx Talks
description: What is the brain? Esther Hale, a senior at Chengdu International School, strives to answer this question as she explores the various mental health disorders around the world. This talk was given at a TEDx event using the TED conference format but independently organized by a local community. Learn more at https://www.ted.com/tedx. Esther is a 12th-grade student from Chengdu International School, who will explore the question, "What is the brain?" She hopes to communicate that there is no single model of the brain that is applied to everyone. This talk was given at a TEDx event using the TED conference format but independently organized by a local community. Learn more at https://www.ted.com/tedx
title: The brain | Esther Hale | TEDxChengdu Intl School Youth

author: TEDx Talks
description:
EN:
This talk traces a life through visible and invisible scars – from childhood accidents and family loss to fainting spells and the body’s memory of trauma. Through theatre, storytelling and everyday acts of kindness, it shows how pain can turn into “golden scars” rather than open wounds. It’s an invitation to see our scars not as shame, but as stories and quiet forms of resistance.

IT:
Questo talk percorre una vita attraverso cicatrici visibili e invisibili – dagli incidenti d’infanzia ai lutti familiari, fino agli svenimenti e alla memoria che il corpo ha del trauma. Attraverso il teatro, la scrittura e piccoli gesti di gentilezza, mostra come il dolore possa trasformarsi in “cicatrici d’oro” invece che restare ferita aperta. È un invito a guardare le cicatrici non come motivo di vergogna, ma come storie e forme silenziose di resistenza. Attrice e regista, attiva nel panorama teatrale e cinematografico italiano.
Ha lavorato in produzioni di cinema d’autore e mainstream, mantenend
title: Cicatrici | Susy Laude | TEDxSalò

author: TEDx Talks
description:
Carla, en esta charla, nos sumerge en ese instante decisivo en el que, en apenas un segundo, la vida puede cambiar para siempre.
A partir de allí, nos invita a recorrer una historia profundamente humana, donde aprender a atravesar —y no sólo aceptar— lo inevitable se transforma en un camino que emociona, interpela y deja huella. Ganadora del Premio Mujer en Innovación, la fundadora de Toradev impulsa una nueva forma de entender la tecnología: útil, accesible y con impacto real. This talk was given at a TEDx event using the TED conference format but independently organized by a local community. Learn more at https://www.ted.com/tedx
title: Dominar lo Invevitable | Carla Torazzi | TEDxMaipú

description:
EN:
Drawing on his journey from drummer to body music performer and educator, this talk explores how rhythm, listening and patience can transform a group into something greater than the sum of its parts. It shows how kindness, connection and shared responsibility turn music into a powerful tool for growth and collaboration.
IT: 
A partire dal suo percorso da batterista a performer di body music e formatore, questo talk esplora come ritmo, ascolto e pazienza possano trasformare un gruppo in qualcosa di più della somma delle sue parti. Mostra come gentilezza, connessione e responsabilità condivisa rendano la musica uno strumento potente di crescita e collaborazione. Batterista e formatore, diplomato alla Drummers Collective di New York.

title: Balotta | Tommaso (Tommy) Ruggero | TEDxSalò

author: TEDx Talks
description:
EN:
Drawing from her journey as an Olympic sailor, this talk explores the role of fear, pressure and vulnerability in high‑performance environments. From the obsession with control to the power of trust and shared responsibility, it shows how accepting one’s emotions can transform both performance and identity. Ultimately, it reframes vulnerability not as weakness, but as a form of courage.
IT:
Partendo dalla sua esperienza come atleta olimpica, questo talk esplora il ruolo della paura, della pressione e della vulnerabilità nei contesti ad alta performance. Dal bisogno di controllo alla scoperta della fiducia e della condivisione, mostra come accettare le proprie emozioni possa trasformare sia la performance che l’identità. In definitiva, la vulnerabilità non è debolezza, ma una forma di coraggio. Pluripremiata velista olimpionica, allenatrice e dirigente sportiva. Ha rappresentato l’Italia in quattro edizioni dei Giochi Olimpici, ed è stata la prima donna a guidare un equipaggio femm
title: L'angolo di incidenza | Giulia Conti | TEDxSalò

author: TEDx Talks
description:
What happens when the systems we build fail to recognise the value already in front of them? 

In this talk, Kia Bing-Davies argues that women over 50 represent one of the most underutilised sources of insight, judgement and experience in today’s organisations. 

The Wisdom Edge is a call to rethink how we define innovation - and to recognise where true wisdom actually lives. Redefining Midlife as a Time of Voice, Authority, and Impact
Women over 50 are one of the most underestimated demographics in the world. Kia Bing-Davies is here to change that.
A former lawyer turned global transformation leader, Kia’s work is about restoring voice, not amplifying noise, and creating space for women to be seen, heard, and valued in the fullness of who they are now. She works at the intersection of leadership, healing, and visibility, supporting women to step out of performance and into truth.

title: Why experience matters in innovation | Kia Bing-Davies | TEDxUniversity of Essex

author: TEDx Talks
description: Kabuta encourages us to look beyond assumptions and make the effort to understand one another truly. Mugi Kabuta is 16 years old. He's a student at St St Austins School and a stern advocate for global reach. His recent experience with an exchange program in 2024 gave him an eye-opening outlook towards the importance of education efforts and believing that people should not only seek within and remain comfortable with the spaces inside, but also reach out and gain the curiosity that can change the spaces around them. This talk was given at a TEDx event using the TED conference format but independently organized by a local community. Learn more at https://www.ted.com/tedx
title: Expanding World View | Mugi Kabuta | TEDxYouth@BrookhouseSchool

author: TEDx Talks
description: The talk explains that while technology has made life easier, it has also increased stress and affected things like attention, confidence, and self-esteem—especially for today’s students. In Bangladesh, even though digital growth is happening, technology is often used without clear purpose, and the speaker stresses that it should serve people, not control them. He argues that many workplace problems are actually human issues, not technical ones, and introduces human-centered leadership, which focuses on helping others (servant leadership), having a clear purpose, and understanding emotions. Good leadership starts from within, with self-awareness and care for others, not just formal training. As newer generations value empathy and guidance more, leaders must adapt. In the end, the key message is simple: no matter how advanced technology becomes, we must prioritize being human in how we lead and interact. Mukhlesur Rahman, PCC, PfMP, is a distinguished telecom and digital strategy leade
title: Human-Centered Leadership in a technology-driven world | Mukhlesur Rahman | TEDxNorthSouthUniversity

author: TEDx Talks
description:
EN: This talk explores how scent, like music, gives form to emotions, memories and inner states through an intangible yet deeply powerful language. By translating feelings such as fear, freedom or nostalgia into olfactory experiences, it reveals how even the most overlooked sense can make the invisible tangible. At its core, the talk reflects on the human need to feel, remember and express through art.

IT: Questo talk esplora come il profumo, proprio come la musica, riesca a dare forma a emozioni, ricordi e stati interiori attraverso un linguaggio immateriale ma potentissimo. Traducendo sensazioni come paura, libertà o nostalgia in esperienze olfattive, mostra come anche il senso più trascurato possa rendere tangibile l’invisibile. Il talk riflette sul bisogno umano di emozionarsi, ricordare ed esprimersi attraverso l’arte. Artista, musicista e profumiere, noto come il sarto dei Papi. La sua ricerca esplora i confini tra spiritualità e materia, trasformando tessuti, immagini e fragra
title: Emozioni, che profumo d'arte | Filippo Sorcinelli | TEDxSalò

author: TEDx Talks
description:
Pourquoi 18 % de l’humanité manque-t-elle à nos imaginaires ?                                  

Jacquelline Simliwa explore comment l’absence de figures africaines dans les récits façonne nos rêves, nos ambitions et notre vision du monde. 

Des Nana Benz à Wangari Maathai, elle montre que ce qui manque dans les histoires finit par manquer dans nos vies. Un appel à ouvrir les livres, les programmes et les imaginaires : l’Afrique n’a pas besoin d’être sauvée, elle a besoin d’être racontée. Jacquelline Simliwa est ingénieure en industrie pharmaceutique en alternance et jeune engagée.

Elle construit des ponts entre science et récits. Arrivée en France depuis le Togo, son parcours est traversé par une quête de légitimité, un engagement pour l’égalité des chances et le désir de transmission.

À travers ses projets et ses prises de parole, elle défend une conviction : apprendre à apprendre est un puissant levier d’émancipation individuelle et collective. This talk was given at a TEDx event
title: L’Afrique qui manque à notre imaginaire | Jacquelline SIMLIWA | TEDxSaclay Women

author: TEDx Talks
description:
Le rapport des femmes au temps est un enjeu central d’égalité. Malgré les principes d’égalité salariale, les femmes disposent de moins de ressources économiques et de temps disponible en raison de la précarité professionnelle et de la charge des tâches familiales. Les normes sociales contribuent également à limiter leur liberté d’action. À ces inégalités s’ajoute une violence physique et symbolique persistante qui conditionne la liberté des filles et entretient des formes de docilité sociale. Elue députée de l’Essonne depuis 2017, Marie-Pierre Rixain est diplômée de Sc Po Toulouse et du CELSA et titulaire d’un DESS de vie parlementaire.
Présidente de la Délégation aux droits des femmes de l’Assemblée nationale entre 2017 et 2022, Marie-Pierre axe son activité en faveur d’une égalité réelle entre les femmes et les hommes, en particulier sur les plans économique, professionnel et fiscal. Elle est notamment l’autrice de la loi visant accélérer l’égalité économique et professionnelle. Thi
title: Les femmes peuvent-elles gagner le temps de vivre ? | Marie-Pierre RIXAIN | TEDxSaclay Women
